regeln: Maintain high motif density with at least 18 genuinely distinct shots per 35-45s Short; never substitute zooms, crops, or static background changes for new motifs.
Prioritize the company logo or main tool as the largest visual element, ensuring it is more prominent than the presenter figure in every frame.
Ground all historical facts and milestones strictly in the past; strictly forbid ungrounded future predictions or anachronistic timeline mentions.
Incorporate specific turning points, comparative scales, and surprise elements to maintain high script tension and pacing.
Establish a high-stakes, information-dense visual hook within the first 3-5 seconds that directly links to the core premise of the video.
Employ the original painted open-world-game style for all visual assets; strictly prohibit stock clips, real game characters, or lifeless documentary stills.
Include mandatory calls to like, share, and save 'this video' at format-appropriate positions, specifically using the word 'video'.
Show genuine tool interfaces and source-supported visual evidence instead of abstract symbols, background-only frames, or filler illustrations.
Integrate the recurring channel presenter early and in active roles throughout the video rather than confining the figure to the conclusion.
Verify anatomical correctness in all images and ensure all props, clothing, and settings accurately match the specific story era.
Ensure every motif change directly illustrates the current spoken point; eliminate all generic filler and ensure perfect alignment between narration and imagery.
Sync captions and narration perfectly to maintain rhythm, eliminating unnatural pauses, dead time, or text-audio misalignment.
